== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The [[Iron Legion]] [[Hive]] is a massive, central structure that serves as the core of the [[Iron Legion]]'s fleet. These [[Hives]] are characterized by a grotesque fusion of organic matter and machinery, often appearing as bulbous slabs or, in the case of the massive [[Grand Hive]], a planet-sized skull composed of black Iron{{!}}iron and white skin. The [[Grand Hive]] specifically functions as a [[fortress]] and was the site where the last [[Iron King]] matured centuries ago. These structures act as nurseries for the [[Legion]]'s leadership and serve as hubs from which thousands of specialized craft are deployed. The [[Hives]] can be used strategically to block transit through space, such as [[Subline]] access, suggesting they can be positioned to conceal the [[Legion]]'s activities. The fleet surrounding a [[Hive]] is composed of ships that are part machine and part living tissue, operating with mechanical coordination despite their haphazard appearance.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The [[Iron Legion]] utilizes [[Hives]] as central structures within their organization. These [[Hives]] function as complex labyrinths composed of living hallways and possess the capability to give birth to a [[King of the Iron Legion]]. During a raid conducted by the [[Fallen Sword]], the potential for facing an entire [[Hive]] becomes a source of concern. Previously, the narrator had fought against one of these [[Hives]] while serving on the side of the [[Vallenar Corporation]].}}
